## Professional Summary

PhD candidate in aquatic ecotoxicology at the Laboratoire Eau Environnement et Systèmes Urbains (LEESU, Université Paris-Est Créteil). My research focuses on the effects of micro- and nanoplastics and their associated additives on the freshwater crustacean *Daphnia magna*. I combine standardised and sub-acute bioassays, behavioural endpoints and the chemical characterisation (target and non-target screening) of plastic leachates. I previously worked on optical brighteners, glyphosate and AMPA, using microalgae, freshwater biofilms and zebrafish larvae. I teach biostatistics and ecotoxicology (about 125 hours since 2024), supervise interns and analyse my data in R, with a particular taste for data visualisation and reproducible reporting with Quarto.

## Professional Experience

-   **PhD Thesis**\
    Laboratoire Eau Environnement et Systèmes Urbains – Université Paris-Est Créteil, Créteil, France\
    Supervision: L. GARRIGUE-ANTAR and T. SRIKANTHASAMY\
    October 2024 – Present
    -   *Ecotoxicological effects of micro- and nanoplastics and their associated additives on* Daphnia magna.
    -   **AOP-NANOP project (ANR-22-CE04-0011)**: acute (OECD 202) and sub-acute (4-day) exposures of *D. magna* to fully characterised polystyrene nanoplastics synthesised by IPREM (Pau). Showed that the residual surfactant carried by the particles, rather than the particles themselves, drove acute toxicity and altered swimming behaviour (infrared video tracking).
    -   **URBIPLAST project (ANR 26-CE34-1363)**: development of a complete workflow to characterise urban furniture made from "recycled plastic": leaching, filtration, solid-phase extraction (SPE), QuEChERS extraction, target analysis by LC-MS/MS and non-target screening by UPLC-IMS-QTOF. Upcoming OECD 202 tests and transcriptomics on *D. magna* exposed to the leachates.

## Skills and Interests

-   **Ecotoxicology**: *Daphnia magna* cultures, acute toxicity tests (OECD 202) and non-regulated sub-acute exposures, swimming behaviour by infrared video tracking, zebrafish (*Danio rerio*) larvae tests (OECD 236, ZebraBox), monospecific algal cultures (*Chlorella vulgaris*, *Microcystis aeruginosa*, *Chlamydomonas reinhardtii*, *Raphidocelis subcapitata*) in axenic or non-axenic conditions, growth inhibition tests (OECD 201), periphytic biofilm cultures in microcosms, PAM fluorometry, design of experimental setups.

-   **Analytical chemistry**: leaching of plastic materials, filtration, solid-phase extraction (SPE), QuEChERS extraction, target analysis by LC-MS/MS, non-target screening by UPLC-IMS-QTOF, sample preparation in synchronous fluorescence spectroscopy, training in HPLC-UV.

-   **Data & IT**: R / RStudio (biostatistics, dose–response modelling, data visualisation), RShiny, Quarto, Git / GitHub, QGIS, Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).

-   **Doctoral training**: QGIS (20 h), research integrity MOOC (15 h), gender equality in science (7 h), using AI in teaching (3 h).

-   **Languages**: French (native), English (C1).
